subject.title: fix(config): bound state-directory .env file reads with size limit

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally skip every global or state-directory `.env` file above 1 MiB during startup, with only an operator warning, rather than preserving the prior unbounded loading behavior?
rationale: This is a valid security-hardening tradeoff, but it changes established startup configuration behavior for existing installations and requires owner acceptance of the 1 MiB limit and fail-open skip behavior.

options.title: Accept the bounded-read policy
options.body: Merge the 1 MiB cap and warning behavior, treating oversized dotenv files as invalid operator configuration that must be reduced or split.

options.title: Preserve oversized-file compatibility
options.body: Keep existing startup behavior by pursuing a different bounded parsing or migration design that does not drop all variables from an existing oversized dotenv file.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded-read policy
recommendation.body: Merge the 1 MiB cap and warning behavior, treating oversized dotenv files as invalid operator configuration that must be reduced or split.
